sources._resolution: working-tree result files when present, otherwise the harness-packaged copies; the two are leaf-for-leaf identical and the emitted table is byte-identical either way

_meta.note: Every leaf is traceable to the source recorded in its own block's 'source' field or in the registry below; regenerate via extract_numbers.py.

onestep_sampled_max_derived._derivation: per model, over all packaged onestep rows: the maximum field-mean VRMSE at each of the four swept floors and the number of sampled starts exceeding ten there (aggregate_results.field_mean_vrmse)

onestep_sampled_mean_by_floor_derived._note: unweighted mean over sampled one-step starts; raw physical units

spatial_displacement_frames_derived._derivation: sqrt(mse) > sqrt(target_var)+sqrt(pred_var), per field-frame, UNetClassic rollout steps 6-12; field index 0 is density

unetclassic_floor_sweep_derived._derivation: UNetClassic rollout window means (same aggregation as the reported cells) recomputed at four denominator floors; eps=0 is the metric's definitional limit, mean_f sqrt(MSE_f/Var_f). VRMSE is monotone decreasing in eps.

map_asymmetry_derived._derivation: hypergeometric: P(all k severe rows carry a '>10' headline | random draw of k from n, of which gt10 carry one)

generalization.method: data-only spatial-variance census, benchmark rollout window frames 4-33; floors eps_lib=1e-7 (headline) and eps_fix=1e-5 (better-conditioned)

benchmark_map.method: data-only spatial-variance census over rollout window frames 4-33, every time-varying field of every dataset (static fields excluded; first trajectory of each sampled file), streamed public test splits; floors eps_lib=1e-7 (library/headline) and eps_fix=1e-5 (better-conditioned)

unit_convention_census_derived._derivation: Z-scored / raw on the reported census cells, using the packaged normalization_std. The Gate-3 figures are single windows; these are the aggregates the manuscript reports.

unit_convention_derived._derivation: library_vrmse_zscored / library_vrmse_raw over Gate 3's nine windows. The convention rescales the floor with the data, so it moves only windows whose denominator the floor carries.

calibration_window_6_12.predictor: data-only quiescent fraction of the file's sampled one-step starts

instrument_agreement.source: normscreen.floor_share recomputed over MAP.json's stored min_var; same expression as assemble_map.py, so this is an internal-consistency check, not an independent re-derivation of the census

gap_scaled_crossing.source: counterfactual from paper_values.table3_13_30 and models.*.rollout_*.lib. Applied like for like -- each checkpoint's own gap factor against its own cell -- the one reported crossing (UNetClassic, 16.46) does not survive: 16.46/2.3726 = 6.939. Two earlier framings of this block, a 'straddle' reading and a 'three of four below ten' count, are withdrawn; see the boundaries section.

onestep_estimator_spread_derived.source: models.UNetClassic.onestep; estimator choice at a fixed floor and split

onestep_estimator_spread_by_floor._derivation: subset mean / interpolated estimate, at each floor
